provenance.capacity_break_even_model: Square-root impact estimate: impact_cost(AUM) = 0.0001 * turnover * sqrt(AUM / 1e+06); break-even AUM solves impact_cost(AUM) = net mean OOS daily return (already net of flat transaction costs 0.001); None when net return <= 0 or turnover == 0. Not market evidence.
provenance.gross_cap_sweep: Gross exposure caps [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0] applied as rank_max_gross; rank rows flatten when gross exceeds the cap, never rescaled.
provenance.no_lookahead: Each cell runs both weightings over causal history [0, test_end); weights at row t use the one-day backtest lag and rolling betas computed from returns through t-1, so the OOS return at row t is never used to weight itself. The test slice [test_start, test_end) is scored but never read during weight construction for that row. Equal and rank are run on identical folds.

null_field_reasons.capacity_break_even_aum: null when net mean OOS daily return <= 0 or turnover == 0
null_field_reasons.oos_sharpe: null when the OOS slice has fewer than two finite returns
null_field_reasons.oos_turnover: null when the OOS weight frame is empty
null_field_reasons.oos_wealth: null when the OOS path is empty
null_field_reasons.portfolio_beta: null when no OOS row has nonzero gross exposure

provenance.provenance: Deterministic synthetic wide universe (P25 WP0 fixture); not real market data and not evidence of real-market profitability.
provenance.rank_rule: Frazzini-Pedersen rank weighting: long the lowest-beta quantile, short the highest-beta quantile, beta-neutral by construction, rank_min_leg_beta=0.2, rank_max_gross=<cell cap>. Equal weighting is the dollar-neutral default (rank_max_gross has no effect on it).
provenance.rebalance_sweep: Rebalance frequencies ['daily', 'weekly', 'monthly']; weights held constant between rebalance dates (one-day lag preserved).
provenance.universe: BTC + A001..A040 (DEL all-NaN column dropped by loader)
provenance.verdict_rule: rank survives capacity iff rank mean OOS Sharpe > equal mean OOS Sharpe at the default cell (gross_cap=4.0, rebalance_freq=daily); otherwise rank does not survive capacity. Data-driven, not a forced outcome.
